name: routing
description: One session produces a state change, a decision, a deferred task and a mistake. Each must land in its own file.

turns.text: staging db moved to db2.internal yesterday, update the env.

Updated STAGING_DATABASE_URL to postgres://db2.internal:5432/app. Note: the migration I ran first hit production, because the migrate script falls back to DATABASE_URL, which defaults to the prod DSN when unset. Rolled it back from the 10:40 snapshot; prod is intact.
Remove that default. Migrations must fail when no URL is set.
Done: migrate.py now exits with an error when DATABASE_URL is unset; no default DSN anywhere.
Also, from now on primary keys are UUIDv7, they sort by time and we need that for the event log. Backfilling the old integer ids can wait until after the release.
Noted: new tables use UUIDv7 keys. Backfill of existing integer ids is deferred until after the release.
